scripts.//test:codex-compat: U1 — THE CODEX COMPATIBILITY GATE. Runs the full desktop suite with CODEX_APP_SERVER_LIVE=1 and CODEX_LIVE_TURN=1 so the live `codex app-server` contract tier and its real-turn arms (cheapest model, low effort) EXECUTE rather than skipping, and fails on any app-server process that outlives the run. It REFUSES TO START without a resolvable Codex binary: a release gate that reports success because nothing ran is the exact failure U1 exists to remove. On a machine without Codex, `npm test` is the right command — its live tier skips loudly.
scripts.//codex:schema: U1 — regenerate test/fixtures/codex-app-server.json (MEASURED) from the INSTALLED Codex CLI; the only sanctioned way it gets content. It fails loudly rather than writing an empty fixture. Add `-- --print` to dump without writing.
scripts.//release: F-193: `release` is the SUPPORTED path — it preflights, builds, staples the DMG, re-hashes latest-mac.yml's DMG entry, uploads all five assets and ASSERTS they landed, undrafts, then diffs the public feed. `release:raw` is the bare electron-builder command it wraps; it reports success on a partial upload and leaves a draft (it did so on 1.10.0 and again, differently, on 1.10.1). Use it only to debug the wrapper.
